title: Machine run for a fixed number of steps
statement: Let $A$ be a memory-machine program, let an oracle assign a Boolean answer to each of $d$ deciders and each bit string, and fix an input bit string $x$. The configuration after $n$ steps from configuration $c$ is the result of iterating the one-step transition $n$ times from $c$.
hypotheses_covered: $A$ maps control states to memory-machine instructions
the oracle maps a decider index and bit string to a Boolean
$c$ is a machine configuration with memory
